categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials and their precursors. Its core products include ternary cathode materials (NCM811, NCA, NCMA, Ni90 and above ultra-high nickel series), lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode materials, sodium-ion battery cathode materials, and various precursors. The company also operates in equipment manufacturing related to cathode material production and recycling of battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced proprietary technologies including high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel ternary cathode material production, co-precipitation precursor technology, doping and surface treatment of cathode materials, atmospheric sintering, and metal recovery technologies. It has developed production techniques for sodium layered oxide and polyanion cathode materials, manganese-doped lithium iron phosphate, and solid-state battery materials such as sulfide electrolytes. Manufacturing involves large rotary kilns and integrated precursor-cathode production lines with automation and digitalization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international battery manufacturers and electric vehicle (EV) companies, including major players in China, Korea, Europe, and North America. The products serve the electric vehicle market (passenger cars, commercial vehicles, two-wheelers), energy storage systems, and consumer electronics. The company has established strategic partnerships with top global battery and EV manufacturers, with overseas customers accounting for a growing share of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in China (Zhejiang, Hubei, Guizhou, Tianjin), South Korea, Poland, and has subsidiaries and offices in the United States and Europe. It has a global supply chain and customer network covering Asia, Europe, and North America, with ongoing expansion in overseas production capacity and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Ronbay operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on the production of cathode materials and precursors. It also extends upstream into raw material sourcing and recycling, and downstream through technical collaboration with battery manufacturers and EV makers, positioning itself as a comprehensive cathode material solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel cathode materials, manganese-doped lithium iron phosphate, sodium-ion battery materials, and solid-state battery technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, with a cross-border research system integrating China, Korea, and Japan. Future R&D focuses include next-generation high-energy density materials, solid-state electrolytes, recycling technologies, and digital transformation including AI applications in manufacturing and management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of cathode materials and precursors to battery manufacturers and EV companies. The company also earns income from equipment sales, technology licensing, and investment income from equity holdings. Sales are mainly conducted via direct contracts with strategic customers, with pricing influenced by raw material costs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Ronbay is a global leader in ternary cathode materials, holding over 12% global market share and ranking first worldwide for four consecutive years. It competes with major domestic and international cathode material producers such as CATL, Bick Power, and Samsung SDI. The company differentiates itself through advanced high-nickel technology, globalized production footprint, and comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple battery chemistries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 15.1 billion, a 33.4% decrease year-over-year mainly due to raw material price declines, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 296 million, down 49%. Despite revenue decline, sales volume increased by 21.8%. The company maintains total assets around RMB 24.6 billion and net assets of RMB 8.44 billion. It continues to invest heavily in R&D and overseas capacity expansion, with a strategic focus on long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Ronbay offers high-performance, high-energy density cathode materials with superior cycle life, safety, and cost-effectiveness, especially in high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel series. Its products support emerging battery technologies such as solid-state and large cylindrical cells. The company’s global supply chain, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and integrated recycling technologies provide customers with reliable, sustainable, and innovative material solutions, enabling leadership in the evolving new energy vehicle and energy storage markets.
